Research Software Teaching About

! CFD researcher developing numerical methods for fluid–structure interaction and the onset of instability in fluid flows, and building open-source solvers for large sparse systems.

  • Fluid–Structure Interaction! Coupled dynamics of rigid and flexible bodies in viscous flows
  • Fluid Instability! Linear stability, energy gradient theory, transition and pattern formation in fluid systems
  • Numerical Linear Algebra! Developing fast iterative solvers and high order methods for large-scale problems
  • Mesh-free Multiphysics Modelling! Particle-based solvers for coupled flow, heat and material deformation where fixed meshes break down
